steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: All hands, you are not to change your route without authorization. Pass through the Gastrell's covering bombardment area posthaste.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Cover the General's return to the ship!
Shells rain down on both sides of the mobile force that is moving at full speed. Smoke obscures their whereabouts, and withering artillery fire crushes the Sarkaz troops collapsing upon them.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Wait, two hundred meters ahead – I found something strange belonging to those Nachzehrers!

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: The aura emanating from that throne... seems to be letting those damn devils to replenish their ranks faster.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: They're closing in fast... They're trying to intercept us!

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: General, do we need the flank guard to continue the diversion–

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Commander, we're––

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Run them over. *cough*...

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: (Labored gasps)
Amidst the smoke, silent figures in white robes raise their longswords, sundering the artillery fire falling upon them.
They disappear into the plumes of smoke and dust kicked up by the explosions.

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: Prepare to intercept the enemy. Five, four, three, two––

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Don't disappoint me––

steps.name: Redsteel Guard Member
steps.text: One!

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: The skies... are raining fire––
Not all death is alike, Sarkaz.
Purple flames wreathe the Duke of Wellington's entire mobile unit, and a rising pillar of flames carves out a completely safe domain on the battlefield—
A sanctuary brought by the flames of death.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: You've more than proven your trustworthiness, Lady Eblana.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: And I, too, admire your duel against death.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: However, your injuries are still severe, and the Nachzehrer's deathly aura still eats away at your body.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Your uniform may hide your injuries, but not from me.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Take my hand, Your Grace. You should not be riding these rickety vehicles.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Allow me to personally escort you back to the Gastrell.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: It's just a flesh wound.
The Duke who overcame death ignores the Draco's outstretched hand, his body remaining upright with the help of his cane.
Pain?
Little more than that.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Lady Eblana, your flames still burn a bit too hot.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Make an opening in this wall of flame, and I will lead the way.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: Don't worry. This cane has accompanied me through more dreadful battlefields.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: I will stand atop the Gastrell's bow and await Victoria's call for help.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: As you wish, my ever-faithful lord.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: If your body can no longer sustain your ambition, then I shall rekindle your heart with flames.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Even death shall be no obstacle for your march forward.

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: We are Tara. We shall stand upon the most glorious place in this land––

steps.name: Eblana
steps.text: Together, we shall set this battlefield alight.
'Warning, warning––'
'Damage to the hull is in excess of sixty-five percent. Navigation system offline. Propulsion system offline...'
'Activate backup power supply.'
'The engine room has been damaged, and there's a serious leakage of Originium fuel.'
'At 2:34, the Frederick was struck by three witchcraft shells simultaneously, paralyzing its propulsion system.'
'The combat zone is heavily contaminated by witchcraft. The three supporting frigates are unable to approach, and currently dispatching infantry––'

'The second defensive line has incurred a fierce assault! The 9th Battalion Armored Corps is currently holding back the Nachzehrer infantry. Lieutenant Colonel Blake and Major Mourning have been slain. Captain Seymour is currently in command.'
'The Excelsior has discovered an approaching squad of Nachzehrer casters! We've lost contact with the Intrepid, with no specific coordinates identified...'
'Duke Gododdin's three dreadnoughts are approaching full-speed to provide support. Duke Abercorn and Duke Ashworth's assault battlegroups are also responding to the call for help!'
'Originium activity is so rampant that it's off the charts! What the hell is that? Is the Originium eating our ship?!'

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Grace, the situation is changing extremely quickly.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The surviving Trilby Ashers have already been sent out, and the news they've brought back has been compiled here.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Our men are dying out there, and the Nachzehrers are turning the entire battlefield into a meat grinder.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: *cough*... How many of us are still left?

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Less than a third.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Your Grace should retreat.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Our flagship still retains its defensive capabilities. Even in this condition, it should at least be able to clear a way back for you.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I can't leave.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Aileen, spread the word that I will be staying on the Glory. Use whatever means you have at your disposal.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: If I abandon the front line, the defensive line will inevitably be routed. Victory will be yet another step further away from Victoria.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: What would the other soldiers think of us? That yet another duke has abandoned them?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: When this battle is over, our soldiers must also remember – what price I paid for this victory.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I will continue to draw the Nachzehrers' fire. The other dukes will surely come to my aid.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: They understand exactly what is and is not important at this current moment.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Besides, my elite forces are all here. You are all the support I need.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Nothing more needs to be said–

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Watch out, Your Grace!

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Hmph. We'll start by clearing out this cabin.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Our march towards victory begins from this stronghold.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Grace...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: *sigh* As you command. Then, we must get our hands on the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Stone of the Sword is still here, undamaged. That is our best opportunity for a counterattack.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Is the Trilby Asher who's been in contact with our lovely Vina still alive?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Our communication channels are back online now.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: Excellent. Get in touch with him.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: I have new orders for him.

a.text: 'The enemy line up ahead is going to be hard to handle. Are you sure you want to keep pushing forward?'
'Activating the Realmblade is the best option we have for turning the tides of this battle. We've already come this far – and this is something only we can do!'

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... The Exemplars?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Use your head, soldier. Don't charge right up to the enemy.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: So much blood... Oripathy. And the suppressants... Damn it, we ran out a while ago.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Hang in there a bit longer, and don't move. There's a chance the Originium crystals puncture your lungs.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: It doesn't matter anymore.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Doctor... Sir, just about all our men are dead.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Clark was the second to last one. See that hand over there by your feet? That's all that's left of him.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: What can I do?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...Your name.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Patel. Richard Patel.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Private Patel, from your badge, I see you were assigned to the 9th Battalion Armored Corps and your commanding officer is Lieutenant Colonel Blake.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If I recall correctly, your company's mission is to protect Duke Caster's flagship.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Who are you? Which unit are you from?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Delphine. From the Exemplars.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'm just like you... I despise those enemies. They took everything from me.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But, I still remember my mission. I'm here to aid you, Private Patel.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Aid me?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Duke Windermere is dead. I don't know if our esteemed duke is still with us.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: And then, there's the Iron Duke... That bloody codger, Wellington! He deserted the battlefield!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: What are you people even doing here? What hope do we have for victory?!
Delphine subconsciously glances over at Vina, who stands not far away with the Sighs of Kings strapped to her back.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...Even if the Grand Dukes give up, we will not.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Is that so...?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: He's... not going to last much longer.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Shit, hurry up and spread out! He could implode at any moment – we won't have time to deal with him!
Delphine sees the soldier's bloodshot eyes... There's determination and desire burning within them.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Listen up, Exemplars. There's a contingent of Nachzehrers up ahead.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Put me... into that tank over there.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Wait, Delphine! Don't go near him, I can handle this––

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Allow me to help you, Private Patel.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: ...If this is your last wish.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Thank you...
The battered tank hurtles towards the Sarkaz troops.
Many of the Exemplars had no idea what was going on, until they heard... the one last battle cry an ordinary soldier gave using his life.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We will record all you've accomplished here today.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Each and every member of the Duke of Caster's 9th Battalion Armored Corps was a good soldier, ready to defend the Gloriana and Victoria herself with their lives.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Wait, what's going on? The dead are standing up?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: No, no... It's not the dead that are standing. They're...
Withered branches.
Twigs sprout from the fallen bodies of the Nachzehrer warriors, extending in every direction, burrowing back towards the fog where the scent of rot and decay is strongest.
A figure rises from the fog and quickly approaches.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Get back, Delphine!

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: (Dull growl)

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Urgh... Luckily, it'll take more than that to kill me off.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If we die here, our lives will get sucked up by the Nachzehrer altars, and we'll turn into their food.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Does that mean... Private Patel's last wish was in vain? If these enemies cannot even be defeated by death...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No, Delphine. He was able to slay this squad of Nachzehrers.

spans.text: able to slay this squad of Nachzehrers.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: However––

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That monster's clearly weakened, and trying to feed off death. Take advantage of this opportunity and destroy the target!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'll cover you! Bagpipe, mark my flank!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Private Patel's wish will not be in vain. We'll charge out through the opening he created.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Everyone, move it!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't hesitate. Slow down for a second, and the whole situation might spiral out of control.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What are you still standing there for?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You... Don't tell me, you're choosing now of all times to get cold feet?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Getting cold feet? No, I just need to stay behind for the time being to fulfill my duty.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Highness, Alexandrina, please don't glare at me like that. I really do have urgent business to attend to.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Duke has just given me her latest orders––

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The deal is off. You are to evacuate with the Sighs of Kings, and await her further instructions.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You will not be able to reach the Stone of the Sword, and this 'key' must not fall into Sarkaz hands.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If necessary, 'special measures' can be employed to ensure the safety of the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How did I see this coming.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: There's no need to be so wary of me. I have been completely forthcoming when it comes to the Duke's orders.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I know you're loathe to abandon your quest for the Stone of the Sword, but...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Count me in.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My highest priority remains to ensure the safety of the Duke.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: *sigh* But at a time like this, where am I supposed to find allies more trustworthy than the Exemplars?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Your duke's not going to be happy with your decision.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Would you look at that, we've already switched sides.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Look at it this way – I'm outnumbered here, and I don't have any way of dealing with all of you.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Go, Your Royal Highness. I hope your plan is a complete one.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't worry. My dear aunt won't have anything to worry about... I know what I have to do.
Vina's plans are never complicated, and that has proven surprisingly effective on this chaotic battlefield.
Everyone in the Exemplars knows exactly what they're fighting for.
Now matter how the war forces them apart, in the end, those who survive will gather to lift the glass of victory.

a.text: 'The plan is straightforward – Delphine, you're in charge of commanding from the periphery and pinning down the Sarkaz laying siege to the Gloriana.'
'Chip away at them, and avoid direct engagements.'

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Can you still walk?

steps.name: Exemplar Soldier
steps.text: I... don't think so...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Then, grab onto my back.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I've moved you to safety... Well, there's nowhere's that's safe anymore.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But let's get behind that piece of the destroyed warship. Hide behind there for the time being.

steps.name: Exemplar Soldier
steps.text: Don't worry about us... Right now, urgh... the Sighs of Kings takes the highest priority!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Don't be daft.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Vina's team knows what to do with the Sighs of Kings. Our mission right now is to contain the enemy and siphon off some of their firepower.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Lieutenant, I need medical assistance over here!

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Fitz, where are you from?

steps.name: Exemplar Soldier
steps.text: Eastham... *cough*––

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I've been there before. They've got good leather.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: There's an open wound on the leg with visible puncturing. Stop the bleeding first. Do you have pain anywhere else other than the wound?

steps.name: Exemplar Soldier
steps.text: No, I'm just... a bit tired, that's all...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Do you have anyone on your mind right now, Fitz?!

steps.name: Exemplar Soldier
steps.text: Barry... from across the street. He still owes me–

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Don't say it. Just keep repeating it in your heart. Just repeat it to yourself over and over!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Then, go back home alive and tell him yourself!

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: The patient is conscious and has no fractures, internal bleeding, or acute infection.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Alright, the wound has been cleaned. I will now bandage it and apply anti-inflammatories. He should be fine with some rest.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: You did well, Delphine.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Lieutenant, do you ever think about wanting to rewind time to the day our ship was raided?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: If we can win, sure.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'm of the same mind.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Because of my mistakes, my incompetence... we were miserably defeated by the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I don't want that to happen again today.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Lieutenant, please take Fitz back. I'm still needed here.

a.text: 'Travel lightly, quickly break through the encirclement, and go for the pedestal. Horn, Bagpipe, we're counting on you to cover our flank!'
'You heard that, Hannah, Morgan, Dagda? We're gonna charge forward and never look back!'
'Sounds like we're rushing straight into a fight for our lives! I'm getting excited already!'

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This bunker's not gonna hold!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Where's the location of the next bunker?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The Strange Man in the Hat's already found it for us. Keep your eyes peeled for his signal!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Those soldiers up there are Caster's guards! We're almost there!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The bombardment is thinning out! Delphine's forces have managed to draw away a large chunk of their firepower!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can see the pedestal clearly now–

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hold on! That attack just now wasn't from the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain, it's the Gloriana!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Gloriana has noticed us.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Its guns are clearing the way for us!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Pounce on to it! Press onward!
They continue to charge into the tempest, to where the artillery fire converges, to where their enemies are.
Hammer smashes into bone, and sword cleaves through flesh.
Those standing shoulder-to-shoulder are getting heavier injuries, yet they no longer bother to wipe the blood from their faces.
They continue pressing forward. No matter how perilous, they never stop.
The Gloriana is right there in front of them, and Vina can already hear the roar of battle coming from above.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hold out a bit longer. We're about to break through–
'(Indistinct Sarkaz language) You shall...'
'(Indistinct Sarkaz language) ...not pass.'

a.text: I've lost all sensation... in the arm holding my hammer...

steps.text: 'Vina!'
'The Sighs of Kings! The Sighs of Kings has been knocked flying! After it––'

a.text: The Sigh... of Kings? That's... the sword? But I... had it on my back...

steps.text: '(Indistinct Sarkaz language) Death...'
'(Indistinct Sarkaz language) ...the final end'
'Damnit! Vina, stand up!'
'Help her! Bagpipe, cover my back! I need to reload!'
'I can block their blades! Bloody hell, why can't I run any faster?!'

a.text: A dark shadow... Something... is approaching me...

steps.text: 'Vina!!!'
'Victoria...'
'Victoria!'
'Victoria!!'
Vina could never forget that voice, even if she can on longer make out all the information it contains.
But, her intuition tells her... that it is a name. A name that is associated with her entire life.
The ground shatters, and along with it, three mobile altars.
White vapor erupts, and a fiery red blade emerges.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Look – a Steam Knight!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: A Steam Knight stands with us!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Victoria's glory has returned, and he stands with us!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Follow him into battle!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Slay them! Slay every last Sarkaz!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: 'Glooooory–– to Victoria!!!'

steps.name: Charles Lynch
steps.text: (Muffled gushing sound)
Slash. Pierce. Charge.
The suit of armor fights valiantly, and ferociously.
The path behind him is soon littered with Sarkaz corpses and the fragments of shattered altars.
Witchcraft missiles fall at his feet, crossbow bolts fly towards him, blades slash at his body.
But, he never stops. He cleaves apart the next enemy, sweeping them away, along with any traces they left on him.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: A Steam Knight... still lives?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's right. We saw him inside the city.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But why... is he here now?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He came... for the sword...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I... can still fight!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But... the sword is gone!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I see the Sighs of Kings! It's lying atop of a pile of bodies in the combat zone. I'll retrieve it for you.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Just as you said – pounce on to it, and press onward. Don't look back.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I promise you that the sword will appear when it is needed.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I will keep going. Cover me.
She clenches the hammer in her hands, shrugging off all doubt and hesitation.
She has placed her trust not just in her partners, but also in people who she had never trusted before... No, she placed her trust in all of Victoria.
The Victoria she believes in.
Run. Faster. Almost there...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Don't force it!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Get hit again, and you're a goner!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The mobile altar...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ––It stopped?!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Then, who fired that shot...? One of our own tanks?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Vina, we're connected with the Duke of Fife's suit of armor! We've also located Captain Seymour – he's still alive! More troops are on their way to join us!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We'll handle all those altar that are flying around!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Great news! Let's keep moving!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't you dare get in our way!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We've used up the last of our ammunition. That means... it'll come down to some good old CQC.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Roger that, Captain!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Pretty nostalgic, right? Reminds me of our academy days.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let's see how these Sarkaz like our technique.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let them try... to get past us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Stone of the Sword is right ahead, but that corrosive fog...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Royal Highness, my colleagues have secured the Gloriana.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: *cough*... The next time our cooperation is needed, the Exemplars will hear from this Trilby once more.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Finally, allow me to use my Originium Arts... as well as a little bit of authority, to light your way.
A ray of green light cuts through the dense fog of decay.
Deep within the storm, the Stone of the Sword radiates with light.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Oh right, the sword...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: After thinking things through, one really should not disobey a duke's orders––

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But I also made a promise to Your Royal Highness. That's quite a pickle.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Alright, then. Catch!
A silver light streaks across the battlefield, piercing through the fog.
The Sighs of Kings. A blade so common that it does not attract the attention of soldiers on either side of the battlefield––

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I've got it!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't turn back now, Siege! This is the final stretch!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Dun worry about me, Captain! Go with them!
The storm rises from the battlefield, but the White Wolf has already leapt up.
Aim, fire. A procedure she knows by heart.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Take it, Siege!
The longsword left her hand, cutting through the air as countless eyes followed its path.
Vina never looks back. She simply continues running, carefully listening to every last sound.
Swoosh.
The sound of metal vibrating through the air. The sound of air being cut apart by a sharp object.
She forcefully throws down the hammer in her hands. Its massive head lodges into the cliffside, creating a tiny foothold for her.
She steps on it, and leaps. And when she extends her hand, the Sighs of Kings has already found its way into her palm.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Indra, Morgan, remember how we used to chuck Molotov cocktails down the chimneys of the nobles?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Yeah, we'd stand on each other's shoulders!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But this time, I'll be running ahead first.
The Originium beneath her feet feel like alive, unlike any wall or mountain she's ever traversed before.
How much farther?
How much longer will it be until the dark clouds disperse, and the war draws its last breath?
She fled Londinium to the land beyond its walls; then from there, she returned. How much farther must she go... before she returns to her peaceful homeland, and to the people she loves?
Vina does not know. But at least, the Stone of the Sword is right before her eyes. She extricates her hammer with all her might.
She knows what she must do.
